responsibility: This file implements the eBPF backend support for CO-RE-related builtins and preserve_access_index lowering. It resolves front-end CO-RE builtins into an internal relocation builtin representation, expands that builtin into target-specific RTL unspecs, records and processes relocation metadata for final .BTF.ext emission, and defines the BPF-specific GIMPLE pass that walks preserve_access_index-marked accesses, rewrites eligible field/type/enum expressions into CO-RE-safe forms, and threads default values and relocation labels through later code generation.
same_name_distinction: Implements the executable behavior of the CO-RE builtin subsystem: builtin resolution, RTL expansion to UNSPEC_CORE_RELOC, final relocation recording/output hooks, and the preserve_access_index lowering GIMPLE pass, whereas core-builtins.h only defines builtin IDs/enums and declares those entry points.
